flow: Open the official Acxiom opt-out form (isapps.acxiom.com)
Select the segments to suppress: mailing address, phone, email
Enter your name, emails, phones and addresses
Complete the CAPTCHA and submit
Click the confirmation link Acxiom emails you and submit again to finalize
Acxiom.notes: Form verified live (HTTP 200) Oct 2026. CAPTCHA + email confirmation are mandatory, so the agent prepares and a human finishes those two steps. India contact per Acxiom: Datenschutz@acxiom.com.

flow: Open the opt-out search page and find your record (name + state)
Select the record and enter your email
Click the confirmation link BeenVerified emails you
Removal completes after email confirmation
Open the Epsilon data-subject request form
Request deletion + opt-out of sale
Submit with your name and email
Watch your inbox for their confirmation
Open the removal page
Find your record and open it
Confirm removal on the record page
Re-check after a few hours
FastPeopleSearch.notes: Sister site of TruePeopleSearch — same flow.

flow: Use the PeopleConnect suppression tool (linked from the opt-out page)
Verify your email, find your record, suppress it
Covers Instant Checkmate + TruthFinder + Intelius in one run
Instant Checkmate.notes: See Intelius playbook — same suppression backend.

flow: Open the Intelius privacy / opt-out page (PeopleConnect suppression)
Enter the email used on your record and verify it
Search and select your record in the suppression tool
Confirm suppression
Intelius.notes: Suppression is run by PeopleConnect and covers Intelius, TruthFinder, Instant Checkmate and US Search together.

flow: Open the LexisNexis consumer portal
Choose opt-out / freeze where eligible
Submit the form; some requests ask for ID to verify identity
Save the confirmation reference in the tracker notes
LexisNexis Risk Solutions.notes: Risk/insurance data — some records are legally retained; opt-out limits marketing use.

flow: Generate the erasure letter in LeakGuard (DPDP/GDPR/CCPA)
Send it to privacy@mylife.com with your profile URL
If they refuse, call their privacy line and reference the letter date
Mark Rejected in the tracker if refused — re-file in 30 days
MyLife.notes: MyLife often resists web-form removal; a dated written request is the reliable path.

flow: Find your Nuwber profile and copy its URL
Open the removal form (nuwber.com/removal/link) and paste the URL
Enter your email and click Remove / Opt Out
Click the confirmation link in Nuwber's email — removal completes in ~24-48h
Nuwber.notes: Removal URL corrected Oct 2026 to /removal/link. Nuwber's domain refused all connections from the dev server network during testing — probe from a home connection (local runner) if the server reports it unreachable.

flow: Open the opt-out page and search your name
Select your record
Enter your email and submit
Confirm from the email if one arrives
Find your Radaris profile and copy the URL
Open the removal page, paste the URL
Complete their verification prompts
Re-check the profile after 3-5 days
Radaris.notes: Radaris is known for slow / resistant removals — the tracker will flag it for re-filing after 7 days.

flow: Search your name on spokeo.com and copy your listing URL
Open the opt-out page and paste the listing URL + your email
Open the confirmation email from Spokeo and click the removal link
Listing usually disappears within 24-48h — re-check and mark Removed
Spokeo.notes: Email confirmation is mandatory; the script can pre-fill but cannot click your mailbox link.

flow: Open the opt-out page
Enter your name, email, phone and address exactly as listed
Submit the opt-out
Re-check your listing URL after 24h
ThatsThem.notes: Opt-out URL fixed Oct 2026: /optout (the old /opt-out returns 404).

flow: Open the removal page
Find your record and open it
Tick the confirmation boxes and submit removal
Re-check the record URL — it should return 'not found'
TruePeopleSearch.notes: Sometimes shows a checkbox CAPTCHA; if the probe reports CAPTCHA, finish in a browser.

flow: Use the PeopleConnect suppression tool (linked from the opt-out page)
Verify your email, find your record, suppress it
Covers TruthFinder + Intelius + Instant Checkmate in one run
TruthFinder.notes: See Intelius playbook — same suppression backend.

flow: Find your listing on whitepages.com and copy its URL
Open the suppression page and paste the URL
Verify ownership with the automated phone call code
Submit — premium listings may need a Whitepages account
Whitepages.notes: Phone-call verification means a human finishes this one; the agent prepares everything before that step.
